title: Nvidia's Potential Financing Deal with OpenAI Sparks Interest
description: Nvidia is reportedly in discussions with OpenAI to secure a significant financing deal for data center infrastructure.

sources.title: Exclusive | Nvidia in Talks With OpenAI to Guarantee $250 Billion Financing for Data Center
Nvidia's $750 Billion Deals Revive Fear of AI Circular Financing
CoreWeave and Nebius gain after report links Nvidia to major OpenAI infrastructure financing

sections.heading: Nvidia and OpenAI Financing Talks
paragraphs: According to the Wall Street Journal, Nvidia is in talks with OpenAI to guarantee $250 billion in financing for data center infrastructure.

sections.heading: Market Reaction
paragraphs: Yahoo Finance reports that following the news of Nvidia's potential involvement in major OpenAI infrastructure financing, companies CoreWeave and Nebius have seen gains in their stock prices.

sections.heading: Concerns Over AI Circular Financing
paragraphs: The Financial Post raises concerns about Nvidia's $750 billion deals, suggesting they may revive fears of AI circular financing.

faq.q: What is the reported amount of financing Nvidia is discussing with OpenAI?
faq.a: Nvidia is reportedly discussing a $250 billion financing deal with OpenAI for data center infrastructure, as per the Wall Street Journal.

faq.q: How has the market reacted to the news?
faq.a: Following the report, companies CoreWeave and Nebius have experienced gains in their stock prices, as noted by Yahoo Finance.

faq.q: Are there any concerns regarding these deals?
faq.a: The Financial Post expresses concerns about the potential revival of fears related to AI circular financing due to Nvidia's $750 billion deals.
